summary: @servicetitan/modularpayments-webfields preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package's preinstall step runs setup.mjs, which downloads the Bun runtime binary from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases (v1.3.13), extracts the platform-specific executable, chmods it, and then invokes it against a bundled ~727 KB file math_init.js. Both setup.mjs and math_init.js are heavily obfuscated (string-array rotation, hex-named identifiers, `@bun @bun-cjs` header with a one-line body). The package is advertised as a browser payment-fields SDK, a purpose that does not require an alternate JavaScript runtime or an obfuscated install-time payload. Executing bundled code under a freshly downloaded runtime at preinstall time bypasses Node-focused inspection and hides the payload behavior. Endpoint host is github.com/oven-sh/bun (legitimate Bun release infrastructure), but the code executed under that runtime is the package's own opaque bundle rather than the Bun tool itself.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
